method.aggregation: per-trial median of complete windows; the two rounds are reported separately and as a mean, no significance claim
method.agent: actual weighted_agent.py, relative weights only, no performance target; exploration and policy transitions stay inside the measured windows
method.measurement: same maximum 5 HTTP probes per sampling cycle under every arm
method.processes: same workload PIDs across the arms of a block; freshly restarted between blocks
method.scope: single VMware guest, descriptive course-design comparison
